title: Lange v. California (2021)
key_points: Holding: Pursuit of a fleeing misdemeanor suspect does not automatically justify a warrantless home entry; it depends on the facts of the case.
officer_notes: Scenario: A driver ignores your lights for a noise violation, pulls into his garage, and you follow him in.
Takeaway: Weigh the seriousness and true urgency before entering a home in a minor-offense pursuit.
